verifier.full_credit: Reference solution scores 1; doing nothing or a forged recording scores 0.
verifier.quote:
The case's tests/verify.py does:

    entries, seal, problems = load_export(EXPORT, api=..., backend=..., scene_sha256=...)
    ... replay `entries` in a fresh simulator, compare every recorded state, evaluate the success check on the
        replayed states ...
    main(grade)    # writes /logs/verifier/reward.txt and details.json

oracle.quote:
The reference solution, which works through the same interface, scores 1; doing nothing, and any
  forged recording, scores 0.

exceptions: GPU tier is optional and will open later on the bench's GPU pool
runtime.quote:
Every case starts with a CPU tier that runs in ordinary Docker containers, and the CPU tier is a complete case on its
own. An optional GPU tier on the bench's GPU pool will open later ([docs/LADDER.md](docs/LADDER.md)).
